title: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass European Style | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom with a freestanding toilet tissue stand that requires no wall mounting and makes roll changes quick and easy.

  • Freestanding design: no drilling or wall installation required
  • Easy roll changes: European style hook simplifies replacing toilet tissue
  • Steady placement: heavy base helps prevent tipping
  • Solid brass construction: crafted for enduring use
  • Finish options: available in a wide variety of designer finishes, including statement colors

Specs

  • Category: Freestanding Toilet Tissue Stands
  • Material: Brass
  • Overall dimensions: 26-Inch H x 6.75-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W
  • Weight: 4.8 lb
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • Included: Toilet tissue stand
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Assembled in the USA

Designed to complement traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.

_previous.title: Free Standing European Style Toilet Tissue Holder
_previous.description: This elegant free standing toilet tissue stand provides a decorative touch to your bathroom. European styling makes changing the roll quick and easy. This toilet tissue stand is a great product when wall space is at a premium. Made of the finest solid brass materials with a sturdy base that will keep the stand secure. Designer finishes will provide a lifetime of use.
